comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C35-C45 regarding innate immune responses to Ym1 crystals. OpenEval rated UNCERTAIN due to the critical limitation that soluble Ym1 crystallizes in vivo, confounding the comparison. Peer reviewers rated SUPPORTED and explicitly affirmed the findings as 'compelling' and 'robust', without raising concerns about the soluble control limitation.

Perfect agreement on claims C56-C60 regarding T cell proliferation and Th2 polarization. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval noted the soluble control limitation applies but data are clear. Peer reviewers affirmed the data 'directly address the aims' and praised logical flow, with no methodological concerns raised.

Strong agreement on crystallographic claims C24, C27-C34, and C89. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval provided detailed technical validation of structural data. Peer reviewers explicitly praised crystallography as 'a major strength' and 'particular strength' with no concerns raised about these findings.

Strong agreement on DC activation claims C49-C55. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval noted clear statistical significance and appropriate gating strategy, with soluble control limitation applying. Peer reviewers explicitly affirmed CLPs 'aid activation and trafficking of antigen presenting cells' with no methodological concerns.

Strong agreement on type 2 inflammation claims C61-C63, C66. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval noted clear data with minor inference limitations. Peer reviewers described data as 'compelling' and 'extremely high quality', with editor emphasizing importance of demonstrating Ym1 crystals promote type 2 immunity.

Agreement on broader conclusions C94-C96 about protein crystallization in type 2 immunity. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval found synthesis reasonable. Peer reviewers implicitly supported through enthusiasm, noting work is 'major advance to the field' and relevant to type 2 inflammatory disease researchers.

Agreement on antibody response claims C68-C70, C82-C83. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval noted IgM data clearly demonstrated with reasonable speculation about mechanisms. Peer reviewers did not raise concerns, accepting these findings as part of overall 'compelling' and 'high quality' characterization.

Perfect agreement on claim C90 regarding untested assumption about Ym2 immunostimulatory effects. Both rated UNCERTAIN. OpenEval noted speculation is explicitly not tested. Both peer reviewers independently noted this limitation, stating 'it would have been nice' or 'interesting' to test Ym2 function, but accepted it as reasonable future work.

Partial overlap on IgM claims C82-C83. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval provided detailed contextualization with prior work on MSU and cholesterol crystals. Peer reviewers accepted these findings without specific comment as part of overall high-quality immunogenicity characterization.

Minimal overlap on claim C74 regarding immunostimulatory effects. Both rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval synthesized literature with current findings, noting soluble control limitation. Peer reviewers supported broader implications about relevance to type 2 inflammatory disease without specific comment on C74.
